raw_output:
**Final Information**

*Based on historical climate normals (1991‑2020), the average daytime high temperatures in Richmond, VA during the winter months (December‑January‑February) are:*

| Month      | Mean daily high (°F) | Mean daily high (°C) |
|------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| December   | 51 °F | 11.1 °C |
| January    | 47 °F | 8.9 °C |
| February   | 51 °F | 11.1 °C |

*Average of the three months ≈ 49.7 °F (≈ 9.2 °C).*

**Sources**

1. **US Climate Data – Richmond Climate Normals (1991‑2020)**  
   The table lists monthly daily highs: Dec = 51 °F, Jan = 47 °F, Feb = 51 °F.  
   (https://usclimatedata.com/climate/richmond/virginia/united-states/usva0652)

2. **NOAA National Climatic Data Center – Richmond Daily Climate Data PDF**  
   The “NORMALS OVER 1991‑2020” section lists January daily mean highs around 48 °F and February highs around 49 °F, confirming the same range.  
   (https://www.weather.gov/media/akq/climateRECORDS/RIC_Climate_Records.pdf)

These figures give a clear sense of the typical daytime warmth that residents and visitors can expect in Richmond during the coldest months of the year.
